name: Update AppIcon image handling
description: The conversation focused on enhancing the AppIcon.vue component to handle image-based app icons with fallback logic. The user requested that icons could be HTTP URLs or data URIs, with automatic fallback if image loading fails. The implementation added image state management (loading, success, error), a fallback mechanism that tries the app's favicon.ico if the primary image fails, and proper state transitions between spinner, image, and default icon displays. Key changes included adding data properties for image state, computed properties for URL determination, and watch/mounted lifecycle hooks to manage icon loading.

messages.content: Icon path can be an image "http..." or "data" check if it's image and if it fails try another fallback option
